payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the shared store layer?
payload.body: The candidate is a hyp commit. Every mechanism the lines name can sit in one candidate, so no two options pass the difference test: the run adds each candidate commit as a Hypothesis, with the base as its rival.

why: The build question of G-1391DM, from the 2026-11-13 grill.
The issue this Goal is part of.
The layout Goal that builds on this one: one view over every store.

payload.summary: Grill of #138 done: G-1391DM builds the store layer both layouts need (lines 1 to 6); Q-75N8YM asks which commit; the layout, a view over every store, is #168. Nothing awaits the owner.
